title: Blocker
html:
"When the inputted signal on the right is 0.0, the inputted signal on the left will be outputted."

The Blocker is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. The Blocker is related to and is very similar to a relay, but has the opposite functionality.

Functionality

The Blocker is primarily used to pass along signals when the signal from the right input is off. This allows for logic circuits to be activated when a different part of the circuit is turned off.

On the input side with two ports, the left input will be the input that voltage is allowed to pass through when the Blocker is 'activated.' The right input is used to toggle whether the left input's signal is will be outputted. Any signal greater than 0 on the Blocker's right input will toggle the Blocker to block any voltage passing through the left, resulting in a voltage of 0 being outputted.

For example: A switch being turned off when connected to the right port would then allow the left port to be activated allowing voltage to pass through.
